title: Romantic Bali with Vintage Car Tour
alt: Tirta Empul holy spring temple in central Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Tirta Empul
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Villa resort with a pool, a short ride from Ubud town

activities.name: Central Bali in a vintage Volkswagen
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: A day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen taking in the Bali swing, Tegenungan waterfall, the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul and the rice terraces.

activities.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
activities.description: Banyan trees, moss covered shrines and a few hundred macaques in a sanctuary ten minutes on foot from the Ubud market.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights in a villa near Ubud, with a vintage car day through the temples, waterfalls and rice terraces of central Bali.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden hotel in Seminyak, ten minutes from the beach

activities.name: Tandem ATV ride
activities.description: A two seat quad bike route through rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel, with helmets, boots and a guide ahead of you.

activities.name: Cretya Ubud day club
activities.description: Infinity pools and daybeds above the Ayung valley, with lunch and drinks available, and transfers from the ATV base included.

activities.name: Water sports, Melasti and Uluwatu
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, the white sand of Melasti beach, then Uluwatu temple and the Kecak fire dance at sunset.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with Paluang cliff
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and the Paluang cliff viewpoint above the water.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you after the island day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa in Kuta.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with a quad bike morning, a cliff top day club, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a full day on Nusa Penida.

day_titles.3: Quad bikes and on to Kuta
day_titles.5: Nusa Penida and a spa evening

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your villa resort near Ubud
Rest of the day free by the pool
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
The Tegalalang rice terraces on the way back
3: Breakfast and check out, then a tandem quad bike route
Rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel
Afternoon at the Cretya day club above the Ayung valley
Private transfer down to Kuta and check in
4: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat and jet ski with an instructor
Melasti beach, white sand below the cliffs
Uluwatu temple and the Kecak fire dance at sunset
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and the Paluang cliff
An hour of Balinese massage for two back in Kuta
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The vintage car day is the one couples talk about afterwards. Open sides, no windows, and the whole of central Bali.
expert.tip: Quad bikes and the day club work best on the same day because they are ten minutes apart. Carry a change of clothes, the river crossing soaks everyone, and keep the massage for the evening after Nusa Penida.

summary: Six days for two with a vintage Volkswagen day through central Bali, a tandem quad bike route, a cliff top day club above the Ayung valley, water sports at Tanjung Benoa, Uluwatu at sunset and a full day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour in a vintage Volkswagen; tandem ATV ride; Cretya Ubud day club; water sports with Melasti and Uluwatu; Nusa Penida west coast tour; Balinese massage for two.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
